run_BigGAN_training_local: run BigGAN training locally in debug mode using the Trainer class with a config dictionary
run_BigGAN_training_slurm: submit BigGAN training to a SLURM cluster using SlurmExecutor with GPU and node parameters
create_parser_args: create an argparse parser for BigGAN training configuration using utils.prepare_parser
load_json_config: load and merge a JSON configuration file into the training config dictionary
review_Trainer_class: review the Trainer class that wraps the training run function for local or SLURM execution
